mentoring.unavailableBody: Mentoring is not available right now. Please try again later.
mentoring.volunteer: Mentoring is voluntary: no fee, no payment. No contact details are shown: once your request is accepted, you talk through messaging.

slot.title: Suggest a time
slot.description: {{name}} will see this time in their request; you can discuss it through messaging.

accept.title: Accept this request
accept.description: You will mentor {{name}} on a voluntary basis. Pick one of the wished times, or suggest one later.

decline.title: Decline this request
decline.description: {{name}} will know you cannot mentor them.

cancel.title: Withdraw my request
cancel.description: The mentor will no longer be able to reply.

close.title: End this mentoring
close.description: The mentoring with {{name}} ends; the mentor's place is freed.

reason.label: Reason (optional)
reason.hint: No phone number, email address or exact address.

retire.title: Withdraw my mentor profile
retire.description: You will no longer be shown as a mentor. Your pending requests will be declined and your ongoing mentoring ended. You can become a mentor again at any time.

next.accepted: Mentoring under way: talk through messaging.

detail.notFound: This request is no longer available.
detail.noWishedSlots: No wished time: to be agreed through messaging.
detail.contact: Talk through messaging: no contact details are shared here.

moderation.profileRemoved: Your mentor profile was removed by the moderation team: members no longer see it and it can no longer be edited.
moderation.requestRemoved: Removed by the moderation team: the mentor no longer sees this request.

mine.title: My mentoring
mine.lead: Your mentoring requests and, if you are a mentor, the ones you receive.
mine.sentEmptyBody: Find a volunteer mentor in your country and ask them for mentoring.
mine.receivedEmptyBody: Requests you receive as a mentor will appear here.

search.title: Mentoring
search.lead: Diaspora members help you settle in, on a voluntary basis: housing, studies, work, family and paperwork.
search.label: Find a mentor
search.emptyBody: No active mentor here yet ({{country}}). Come back soon, or become a mentor yourself.
search.emptyDomain: No active mentor in this area ({{country}}). Try all areas.

become.title: Become a mentor
become.description: Offer your help, on a voluntary basis, to members arriving in your country. You choose your areas, your languages and how many people you mentor; you can pause or withdraw at any time.
become.again: You withdrew your mentor profile. You can become a mentor again at any time, with a new agreement.
become.statusInsufficient: Your membership must be declared to become a mentor.

form.presentationHint: {{min}} to {{max}} characters, no phone number, email address or exact address.
form.countryHint: The country of your mentoring is visible to members.
form.cityHint: Shown according to the visibility of the city on your diaspora profile.
form.capacity: People mentored at the same time
form.capacityHint: Beyond this, you no longer receive new requests.
form.reminder: Mentoring is voluntary: no fee. Do not give any contact details here; contact goes through messaging.
form.consent: I choose to appear as a mentor to network members, with my published name, my areas and my country. I can withdraw at any time.
form.created: You are now a mentor, thank you!

panel.title: My mentor profile
panel.pausedNote: Profile paused: you no longer appear in search and receive no new requests.
panel.cityVisibility: Your city is shown according to the visibility of the city on your diaspora profile (settings).

profile.notFoundBody: This profile does not exist, is paused or is not available to you.
profile.title: {{name}}, volunteer mentor
profile.self: This is your mentor profile, as members see it.
profile.alreadyRequested: You already have an open request with this mentor.
profile.full: This mentor already mentors the number of people they chose. Come back later.

request.statusInsufficient: Your membership must be declared to ask for mentoring.
request.title: Ask {{name}} for mentoring
request.description: Your request waits for a reply for fourteen days at most. Once accepted, you talk through messaging.
request.messageHint: Explain your situation in at least {{min}} characters, with no phone number, email address or exact address.
request.reminder: No contact details here: once your request is accepted, you talk through messaging. Mentoring is voluntary.
request.consent: I agree that {{name}} sees my published name, my goal and my message.
request.sentBody: {{name}} receives your request and will reply here, in “My mentoring”.

errors.mentor_consent_required: Tick the box to confirm you choose to be a mentor.
errors.mentor_domains_required: Choose at least one area of help.
errors.mentor_domain_invalid: Choose an area from the list.
errors.mentor_language_invalid: Choose a language from the list.
errors.mentor_country_invalid: Choose a diaspora country of residence.
errors.mentor_city_invalid: Enter a city on one line, without an address.
errors.mentor_capacity_invalid: Choose between one and ten people to mentor.
errors.mentor_capacity_below_active: You already mentor more people: end a mentoring first.
errors.mentor_profile_exists: You are already a mentor: edit your profile from “My mentoring”.
errors.mentor_profile_retired: Your mentor profile is withdrawn: become a mentor again to edit it.
errors.mentor_profile_version_changed: Your profile changed in the meantime. Reload the page.
errors.mentoring_contact_forbidden: Remove the phone number or email address: contact goes through messaging.
errors.mentoring_address_forbidden: Remove the exact address: only give a city or neighbourhood.
errors.mentoring_consent_required: Tick the box to agree that the mentor sees your name and message.
errors.mentoring_domain_not_offered: This mentor does not help in this area.
errors.mentoring_goal_too_short: Describe your goal in a few words.
errors.mentoring_goal_too_long: Your goal is too long: one sentence is enough.
errors.mentoring_slot_invalid: This time is not valid: check its start and end.
errors.mentoring_slot_too_far: This time is too far ahead.
errors.mentoring_time_nonexistent: This time does not exist that day (clocks go forward).
errors.mentoring_time_ambiguous: This time occurs twice that day (clocks go back): choose another one.
errors.mentoring_self_request: You cannot be your own mentor.
errors.mentoring_pair_open: You already have an open request with this mentor.
errors.mentoring_mentee_limit: You already have several pending requests: wait for a reply or withdraw one.
errors.mentoring_mentor_full: This mentor is not taking new requests right now.
errors.mentoring_idempotency_conflict: This request changed since it was first sent. Check it, then send it again.
errors.mentoring_request_expired: This request expired without a reply.
errors.mentoring_request_not_open: This action is no longer possible for this request.
errors.mentoring_action_forbidden: This action is not yours to take.
errors.mentoring_capacity_reached: You already mentor the number of people you chose: end a mentoring or raise your limit.
errors.mentoring_slot_version_changed: The time changed in the meantime. Reload the request.
